effects: The pre-requisite for all further Moduli. The Core lets the User ingest Residue into their Circulation, where it can be burned by other Mods.

attrs.Consumption: Residue is ingested through a port (usually in the chest), able to load very concentrated amounts — potentially millions at a time. Ingesting takes time in Seconds equal to the amount of Residue.
attrs.Preservation: Circulating Residue cannot be extracted and is untouched even by Aether Vacuums, remaining until expended.
attrs.Dissolution: On the User's death, while Circulating more than 100,000 Residue, they detonate — dealing Explosive Damage in a Radius equal to 0.0001 times the Circulating amount.
